titulo: Caber and saber in the preterite
subtitulo: Supe la noticia ayer. No cupimos en el carro.
regla: Caber and saber share an irregular preterite with a u stem and no accents: cupe, cupiste, cupo, cupimos, cupieron; supe, supiste, supo, supimos, supieron. In the preterite, saber usually means found out.

bloques.texto: **Caber** (_to fit_) and **saber** (_to know_) change their stem in the preterite: **cab-** → **cup-**, **sab-** → **sup-**.
They take the special irregular endings: **-e, -iste, -o, -imos, -ieron**. **No written accents**: **supe**, **supo**, not _supé, supó_.
In the preterite, **saber** marks the moment you learned something: **supe** = _I found out_, _I heard_. For what you simply knew, use the imperfect **sabía**.
**Caber** is about space: **no cupo** = _it didn't fit_, **cupimos todos** = _we all fit_.

lista.es: ==Supe== la noticia ayer en la noche.
lista.en: I found out the news last night.
How did you find out I was leaving Tijuana?

lista.es: Nunca ==supimos== quién se llevó la tabla.
lista.en: We never found out who took the board.

lista.es: Mis papás ==supieron== la verdad muy tarde.
lista.en: My parents learned the truth very late.

lista.es: La tabla no ==cupo== en la camioneta.
lista.en: The board didn't fit in the truck.

lista.es: ==Cupimos== los cinco en el carro de Beto.
lista.en: All five of us fit in Beto's car.

lista.es: Las macetas no ==cupieron== en el balcón.
lista.en: The pots didn't fit on the balcony.

lista.es: No ==cupe== en el traje de neopreno de mi hermano.
lista.en: I didn't fit into my brother's wetsuit.

lista.nota: No accent on these irregular forms.

filas.t: La tabla no cabió en el carro.
La tabla no cupo en el carro.
Antes supe nadar, pero ya se me olvidó.
Antes sabía nadar, pero ya se me olvidó.

lista.nota: Knowing how, as an ongoing state: imperfect **sabía**. **Supe** = _found out_.
